product.title: Venice: St Mark's Basilica After-Hours Tour with Optional Doge's Palace

description.text: Experience the magic of Venice's St. Mark's Basilica with an exclusive after-hours, small-group tour. Marvel at the breathtaking mosaics, explore the crypt believed to house St. Mark's remains, and soak in the serene atmosphere without the daytime crowds. Stops include Basilica di San Marco, Doge's Palace, Bridge of Sighs. For an extended adventure, upgrade to include a visit to the Doge's Palace, the historic seat of the Venetian Republic’s government. Ideal for visitors basing in Venice who want a guided city experience without coordinating vaporetto routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Basilica di San Marco, Doge's Palace, Bridge of Sighs that define this Venice sightseeing experience, with a guide handling vaporetto connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
